### BrowserMeter

```ts
type BrowserMeter = Readonly<{
  hold: (input) => Promise<void>;
  start: (input) => Promise<void>;

}>;
```

One metered execution (a lease or a Quick Read), driven only by `createBrowser`.
`maxMs` is the execution's own ceiling: the hold covers it and settlement never
exceeds it.

```ts
}>;
```

`@fungi.computer/oyster/browser`: the one agent browser for the Hub and a
standalone Oyster. A host builds the port from a provider (`browserRunSessions`
or `bindingSessions`, plus Browser Run Quick Reads when it has them), its
required metering owner and an event sink; `createBrowser` owns lease ownership,
egress policy and billing order; `browserCapabilitySource` is the agent's
`cloudBrowser` tool. Raw CDP stays internal to this directory.

### LeaseOwner

```ts
type LeaseOwner = Readonly<{
  teamId: string;
  agentId: string;
  sessionId: string;
}>;
```

The one place that binds a cloud-browser lease to the (teamId, agentId,
sessionId) that opened it, enforces the per-Team concurrent cap, and times
leases out. The provider (`sessions.ts`) only knows CDP connections; it has no
idea which Team or Session owns one. This registry is in-process (one Hub
instance): see the report for why a durable, cross-instance counter (the
`TeamDO`-backed shape Computer admission uses) is the better home for this
long-term.

```ts
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "scroll";
      leaseId: string;
      deltaX: number;
      deltaY: number;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "screenshot";
      leaseId: string;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "pdf";
      leaseId: string;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "close";
      leaseId: string;
    }>;
```

Every call the agent tool can make. `markdown`/`links`/`scrape`/`extract` are
stateless Quick Reads (absent on a host without them); `open`..`close` share one
driven session keyed by `leaseId`. "screenshot"/"pdf" return raw bytes here;
`capability-source.ts` saves them through the host's door and hands the model
only a byte count.

## Variables

### CLOUD\_BROWSER\_DESCRIPTIONS

```ts
const CLOUD_BROWSER_DESCRIPTIONS: Readonly<{
  module: string;
  markdown: "Render a JavaScript page and return it as markdown, truncated to maxChars (default 20000).";
  links: "Render a page and return up to 500 links found on it.";
  scrape: "Render a page and return matched elements for up to 10 CSS selectors, bounded to 64 KiB.";
  extract: "Render a page and extract structured data matching a prompt.";
  open: "Open a driven browser session, optionally navigating to a URL, and return its leaseId.";
  navigate: "Navigate an open session's page to a URL.";
  snapshot: "Read an open session's page as a bounded accessibility-tree text summary.";
  click: "Click at a viewport pixel coordinate in an open session.";
  type: "Insert text at the current focus in an open session.";
  press: 'Press one key (e.g. "Enter", "Tab") in an open session.';
  scroll: "Scroll an open session's page by a pixel delta.";
  screenshot: "Capture a PNG screenshot of an open session's page and save it to a Computer path; returns the saved byte count, never the bytes.";
  pdf: "Render an open session's page to PDF and save it to a Computer path; returns the saved byte count, never the bytes.";
  handoff: "Ask a Team member to take over an open session for a login or captcha; a card appears in the conversation and the run continues once they finish.";
  close: "End a driven session and release its lease.";
}>;
```

The one source of truth for every `cloudBrowser` description: the module itself
and each operation. `cloud-browser-descriptions.test.ts` imports this and
asserts every entry stays under 1000 characters (the acceptance criterion in
`issues/retained-features-v1/02-*.md`); the guard right below repeats that check
at import time so a regression fails fast either way.

## Functions

### createBrowser()

```ts
function createBrowser(host, limits): Browser;
```

`@fungi.computer/oyster/browser`: the one agent browser for the Hub and a
standalone Oyster. A host builds the port from a provider (`browserRunSessions`
or `bindingSessions`, plus Browser Run Quick Reads when it has them), its
required metering owner and an event sink; `createBrowser` owns lease ownership,
egress policy and billing order; `browserCapabilitySource` is the agent's
`cloudBrowser` tool. Raw CDP stays internal to this directory.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                              |
| --------- | --------------------------------- |
| `host`    | [`BrowserHost`](#browserhost)     |
| `limits`  | [`BrowserLimits`](#browserlimits) |

#### Returns

[`Browser`](#browser)

---

### browserCapabilitySource()

```ts
function browserCapabilitySource(deps): CapabilitySource;
```

Compose the `cloudBrowser` source for one Session, on either host. `browser` is
the module's lease door (in-process, or the Hub's egress RPC); `saveFile` is the
host's Computer bytes writer and `requestHandoff` its "needs you" card. A host
without one passes `null` and the matching operations are not offered. A lease
needs a Session identity, so a session-free host (e.g. the MCP execute path)
gets no module at all.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `deps`    | `Readonly`\<\{ `identity`: () => \| `Readonly`\<\{ `teamId`: `string`; `agentId`: `string`; \}\> \| `null`; `browser`: [`AgentBrowserDoor`](#agentbrowserdoor); `quickReads`: `boolean`; `saveFile`: [`SaveBrowserFile`](#savebrowserfile) \| `null`; `requestHandoff`: ((`sessionId`, `reason`) => `void`) \| `null`; \}\> |

#### Returns

`CapabilitySource`
